Shanghai Municipal Council.

C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No. 26
Date .................... January 28th 1916

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

Sir,
On 6th instant Colonel Lieu Ching Sung 劉景双 arrived
here by train from the North. He was accompanied by his
secretary, Liang Tsing Woo 梁振和 and two orderlies named
Sung Tuh San 孫德山 and Lieu Kwaung Yoong 劉光榮. On
arriving at the S.N.R.Station the party hired a carriage,
and ordered the mafoo to drive to the Arsenal. A dispute
arose about the fare on the way thither, and the mafoo
took them to the Louza Station where he complained that
Colonel Lieu had threatened him with a revolver. The Colonel
and his followers were searched in the Charge Room. One
small and two large mauser pistols, as well as a considerable
quantity of ammunition were found in their possession.
They also had a military pass from the General of Fengtien
authorising them to carry 20 revolvers and 3,000 rounds of
ammunition. As a result of inquiries, the men were escorted
to the boundary and released.
With reference to the above it appears that Colonel
Liu and his staff after reporting their arrival to the
Arsenal Authorities, went to reside at No.101 Nyung Kong Li
West Gate, and are still staying there. They have come here
on a secret mission, the true nature of which nobody seems to
know. They are only responsible to the Central Government and
are independent of the local authorities. At first it was
rumoured that Colonel Lieu had come here to watch General Yang,
as the latter was suspected of being disloyal, but it is now
reported that Colonel Lieu is the local Chief of a Corps
which was recently organised for the purpose of assassinating
rebels. Colonel Lieu has been absent from Shanghai for some
days but it is believed that he is not far away. It is said
that he has appointed one of his officers to take charge at No.
101 Nyung Kong Li during his absence. Some twenty persons
frequent this house. They are all reported to be assassins
who are employed to kill those who are opposed to Yuan Shih Kai.
It is reported that a code telegram was received at the
Arsenal yesterday from the Central Government saying that many
officials had secretly left Peking since the rebellion started
in Yunnan. The telegram instructed the Arsenal Authorities
to send detectives to watch the various wharves and railway
stations and arrest any of the runaways whom they saw arriving.

上海义勇队指挥官

上海工部局。

刑事侦缉处
情报官登记册
第 26 号
日期 .................... 1916年1月28日

（印：上海工部局）
警务处，
（侦探股）

先生：
本月6日，刘景双（Lieu Ching Sung）上校乘火车从北方抵达此处。随行者有其秘书梁振和（Liang Tsing Woo），以及两名名为孙德山（Sung Tuh San）和刘光荣（Lieu Kwaung Yoong）的勤务兵。抵达北站（S.N.R. Station）后，一行人雇用了一辆马车，并吩咐车夫驶往兵工厂。途中因车费发生争执，车夫将他们带至老闸捕房，投诉刘上校用手枪威胁他。在候审室对该上校及其随从进行了搜身。在其身上搜出小型毛瑟手枪一支、大型毛瑟手枪两支，以及大量弹药。他们还持有一张由奉天将军签发的军用通行证，授权他们携带左轮手枪20支及子弹3,000发。经查询后，这些人被护送至界路并予释放。
关于上述情况，据悉刘上校及其幕僚在向兵工厂当局报到后，迁居至西门口永公里101号，目前仍居住于此。他们此行负有秘密使命，其确切性质似乎无人知晓。他们仅对中央政府负责，独立于地方当局之外。起初有传言称，刘上校来此是为了监视杨将军，因为后者被怀疑不忠；但现据报告，刘上校是最近为刺杀反叛者而组建的一个军团的地方首领。刘上校已离开上海数日，但相信他并未远行。据说他在离沪期间指派了一名军官负责永公里101号的事务。约有二十人经常出入该宅。据报这些人均为受雇刺杀反对袁世凯者的刺客。
据报道，兵工厂昨日收到中央政府发来的一份密码电报，称自云南爆发叛乱以来，许多官员已秘密离开北京。电报指示兵工厂当局派遣侦探监视各码头及火车站，并逮捕任何被发现的抵沪逃亡官员。

Shanghai Municipal Council.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE (DETECTIVE BRANCH)）
191
(2)
The Arsenal has started working day and night since
the trouble broke out in Yunnan and the number of operatives
has been increased from four hundred to six hundred.
Mr. Zee Koh Liang 徐□□ Chief of the Shanghai
Woosung Police entertained the City gentry to tiffin
yesterday and requested them to use their influence to
induce the merchants and shopkeepers to change to the
new monarchical calendar.
General Lieu Deputy Commissioner of Defence, has
ordered 5,000 pairs of boots which have to be completed
before the Chinese new year.
Colonel Zau Li Wong □□□ Staff Officer to General
Yang visited the German Consulate about 11 a.m. 27th
instant.
Your Obedient Servant,
William Armstrong
Chief Detective Inspector.
Captain Superintendent of Police.

上海工部局。
（印：上海工部局警务处（侦探股））
191
(2)
自云南发生动乱以来，兵工厂已开始日夜开工，工人人数已从四百人增加至六百人。
上海吴淞警察局局长徐□□（Zee Koh Liang）先生昨日宴请本埠士绅吃午饭，并请他们利用自身影响力，促使商人和店主改用新的君主制历法。
副防御司令刘将军已订购5,000双靴子，须在农历新年前完工。
杨将军的参谋官赵立王（Zau Li Wong，音译）上校于本月27日上午11时许访问了德国领事馆。
您顺从的仆人，
威廉·阿姆斯特朗（William Armstrong）
首席侦探督察长。
